_readme: Articles on perspectives.html. 'url' = published elsewhere (opens in a new tab) or an existing page on this site. For an article hosted here, leave out 'url' and put its body (HTML) in tools/perspectives/posts/<slug>.html; build.py then writes perspective-<slug>.html. 'mark' is the big character on the cover; 'short' is a shorter title for the cover only.
